exposure: Type of primary obstetric surgery (cesarean section, laparotomy for ruptured uterus or ectopic pregnancy)
cohort: The study included all cases of unplanned return to the operation theatre within 6 weeks of a major obstetric surgery (cesarean section, laparotomy for ruptured uterus or ectopic pregnancy) at a tertiary care teaching institution.
finding: The incidence of in-house UROT was 0.16%, with intraperitoneal hemorrhage (34.92%) being the commonest reason, often following emergency primary procedures.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean section was identified as a common indication for the primary surgery leading to UROT.
followup_time: 6 weeks (definition of UROT within 6 weeks of primary operation)
